title: MONSTER CFB Game Total Page Order + Slate Cleanup V1
problem: The unselected slate is visually overloaded and the human-facing Page 1/Page 2 semantics are reversed.
root_cause: The prior compact repair squeezes deep analysis into mobile instead of removing it from the slate, while the selected-game hero hard-codes Page 2 of 2 and the unselected route is treated as Page 1.
patch: Use a CFB-only routing context: selected game keeps the frozen full analysis but displays Page 1 of 2; unselected route uses a clean Page 2 slate that hides duplicate deep-analysis surfaces and restores readable native mobile layout.
